summary: This note is a short biography of Lorenzo Richelmy, an Italian actor born 25 March 1990. He is best known outside Italy for playing the title role in the Netflix original series "Marco Polo", and had earlier appeared in several Italian television shows and films. He attended the Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia, where he was the youngest student ever admitted.
one_line: Italian actor born 1990, known internationally for the title role in Netflix's series "Marco Polo".
